attributes.powers: Discard this card to choose a type of card and examine the top 2 cards of your location deck. If there are cards of the chosen type, set them aside. Shuffle the remaining cards into the deck, then put the cards you set aside together in any order on top of the deck.
attributes.recharge: After playing this card, if you do not have either the Arcane or Divine skill, banish it; otherwise, you may succeed at an Arcane or Divine 6 check to recharge this card instead of discarding it.
